translationRepairs: Yet in the age of Tang and Yu, when it was said that "the black-haired people were obstructed by famine," Yi Ji had to be appointed; when "the common people were not affectionate and the five relations were not in order," Qi had to be appointed — from this one knows that harmonious success cannot be assured, just as filial piety and friendship are not easily obtained.
